scenes.action: Armaan kneels on the mint rug and lifts a red ball. Ismat sits opposite, smiles and opens her hands. Bright soft playroom daylight, eye-level framing, normal gentle speed; only the current speaker moves their lips. No narration or text cards.

Armaan slowly rolls the ball to Ismat, who catches it with both hands. Pause on her smile. Bright soft playroom daylight, eye-level framing, normal gentle speed; only the current speaker moves their lips. No narration or text cards.

The ball gently slips away beside a large foam block. Both look at it, then at one another, playfully. Bright soft playroom daylight, eye-level framing, normal gentle speed; only the current speaker moves their lips. No narration or text cards.

They walk to the ball, crouch, and push it back onto the rug together. Show hand contact and continuous ball physics. Bright soft playroom daylight, eye-level framing, normal gentle speed; only the current speaker moves their lips. No narration or text cards.

Ismat rolls the ball back slowly. Armaan receives it, nods and smiles at her. Bright soft playroom daylight, eye-level framing, normal gentle speed; only the current speaker moves their lips. No narration or text cards.

They sit, roll the ball once more and share a short natural giggle. End on their smiles and the ball between them. Bright soft playroom daylight, eye-level framing, normal gentle speed; only the current speaker moves their lips. No narration or text cards.
